name: Miko to Youko no Shuuchi na Nichijou ~Hazukashii kedo... Zenshin de Gohoushi Shimasu~
original_name: 巫女と妖狐の羞恥な日常 ～恥ずかしいけど……全身でご奉仕します～
source: Triangular relationship between two human kimono heroine! Torture and shame is carried out in various places!
translation: 两个人类和服女主角之间的三角关系！在各种地方进行调教和羞辱！
